verdict.rationale: Honcho is a memory layer, so a graph-memory question applies to it. Its evidence shows per-entity state ('peer representations') and modeling of what one peer knows about another. Nothing documents storing memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships, or graph traversal for multi-hop questions, so these entity-centric representations are an adjacent feature, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can store memories as a knowledge graph of entities and relationships so multi-hop and entity-centric questions are answerable
